name: volt
description: Volt is a production-ready TanStack Start boilerplate for building server-side-rendered React apps — a token-driven design system, a dashboard shell, dual RPC (tRPC + oRPC), Drizzle + PostgreSQL, a typed GraphQL SDK via gqlkit, light/dark theming, and typesafe env, all wired end-to-end.

positioning.category: TanStack Start boilerplate / React SSR starter kit
positioning.audience: Solo developers and teams building full-stack React apps
positioning.wedge: Everything is wired end-to-end — design system, dual RPC, database, GraphQL, theming, and typesafe env — so you start on feature work in minutes, not plumbing.
differentiators: Token-driven design system — density and full color palette are CSS variables in one file; retheme or rescale the whole UI by changing tokens
Two RPC layers wired side by side (tRPC v11 and oRPC) plus a typed GraphQL SDK via gqlkit
A polished dashboard shell (sidebar, PageHeader, Surface, StatusBadge, user menu, theme toggle) out of the box
34 Base UI components via basecn, tuned to a compact consistent density
Typesafe everything — routes, RPC, forms, env, and per-route document titles are compile-checked
Demo isolation — the entire showcase is quarantined under /demo so your real app starts clean
